description: Wella's flagship permanent hair color with ME+ (MEA) technology and Metal Purifier. Surreal Color (2025) adds Pure Lift Technology with 1/3 caring lipids. Up to 100% gray coverage. 155 shades including Pure Naturals, Rich Naturals, Vibrant Reds, Deep Browns, Special Mix correctors, and Special Blonde high-lifts.

vibrantReds.description: Copper, red, and mahogany shades with double-pigment options

specialMix.description: Concentrated correctors and intensifiers — use up to 50g per 30g base shade

specialBlonde.technology: Pure Lift Technology with 1/3 caring lipids in color cream

technology: ME+ (MEA) — reduced allergy risk vs PPD
Metal Purifier — encapsulates metals on hair for accurate color formation
Pure Lift Technology — 1/3 caring lipids in Special Blonde cream
applicationNotes: 1:1 ratio — 60g Koleston Perfect + 60g Welloxon Perfect developer
For gray coverage: always include a Pure Naturals shade (XX/0 or XX/02)
Correctors (0/) can be mixed up to 50g per 60g base shade
Double-pigment shades (XX/YY) provide intensified color for vibrancy
Resistant Cover shades (XX/02) for up to 100% gray coverage on resistant hair
Easy rinse — rinse thoroughly, no shampoo required
Post-color: use pH-optimized care products for better color retention

toneSystem.description: Wella International Tone Numbering: Level/Tone format (e.g., 7/43 = level 7 copper-gold)
toneSystem.format: Depth/Tone — first digit(s) = level, after slash = tone reflect(s)
toneSystem.doublePigment: XX/YY format — doubled level digits indicate double pigment intensity (e.g., 77/43 = level 7 with double copper-gold pigment)

grayCoverageNotes: For 30-100% gray: add Pure Naturals shade (XX/0) proportionally
XX/02 Resistant Cover shades for very resistant gray
Double-pigment shades (XX/YY) enhance coverage on gray
